function.arguments:
{"code": "from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from vivo_demo import make_chat_model

# 1. 질문이 들어갈 자리가 있는 프롬프트
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template(
    "당신은 날씨를 쉽게 설명하는 도우미예요. 다음 질문에 짧게 답해 주세요. 질문: {question}"
)

# 2. 테스트용 채팅 모델과 문자열 출력 파서
llm = make_chat_model()
output_parser = StrOutputParser()

# 3. 프롬프트 → 모델 → 출력 파서를 하나의 체인으로
chain = prompt | llm | output_parser


def ask(question):
    return chain.invoke({"question": question})


print(ask("서울 날씨는?"))"}

function.name: run_example
function.arguments:
{"code": "from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain_core.tools import Tool
from vivo_demo import make_model, weather

# 1. 시스템 프롬프트: ReAct 형식 문자열 대신 에이전트의 역할만 알려 줘요
SYSTEM_PROMPT = "당신은 날씨 질문에 답하는 도우미예요. 필요하면 weather 도구를 써서 답하세요."


def answer_city(city):
    # 2. 테스트용 모델과 날씨 도구
    llm = make_model(city)
    weather_tool = Tool(name="weather", func=weather.run,
                        description="도시 이름을 받아 현재 날씨를 알려 주는 도구")
    tools = [weather_tool]

    # 3. 에이전트 만들기 (실행기가 따로 필요 없어요)
    agent = create_agent(llm, tools=tools, system_prompt=SYSTEM_PROMPT)

    # 4. 실행하고 최종 답 꺼내기
    result = agent.invoke({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": city}]})
    return result["messages"][-1].content


print(answer_city("Seoul"))"}

value.description: For maximum flexibility while using the same Deep Agents harness, use Deep Agents and host agents yourself, or run a custom Agent Server. Use create_agent when you need to configure a smaller harness yourself.

value.title: What's new in LangChain v1 - Docs by LangChain
value.description: For a complete list of changes, see the migration guide. ... create_agent is the standard way to build agents in LangChain 1.0. It provides a simpler interface than langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent while offering greater customization potential by using middleware.

value.title: Migrate from langgraph-supervisor - Docs by LangChain
value.description: Instead use the subagents pattern: a main agent coordinates specialized workers by calling them as tools. This guide covers how to migrate from create_supervisor to create_agent, including setups that use interrupt and external API callbacks.
